newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes firmer but off earlier high.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes firmer but off earlier high.

text.p: GOLD - Fixed at $327.55 vs $326.40 AM. Firmer opening in New York met resistance at $328.00. Held in range.
SILVER - Also firmer, off high. $4.39/$4.41, up nine cents. PLATINUM - Up $4.00 at $429.00/$432.00. Tight.
PALLADIUM - Up $5.00 at $207.00/$210.00. Very tight. Pushed up higher on short covering, fund buying.
